head_note: The head of Copilot's first review of the PR.
title: feat: mark jobs in progress, in review and delivering on the live map
notes_basis: The PR description as it is today. GitHub shows no edit of it, and it was opened before the review.
notes:
## What

On the Live map, a job card only changed colour when a job was in review or delivering. Nothing said what the colour meant, and the user guide did not explain it. This adds a marker for each active state, next to the existing blocked icon in the top-right corner of the card:

- `in_progress`: a small light-blue arc that turns slowly.
- `in_review` and `delivering`: a green eye icon and a slow green glow on the card.
- `blocked`: unchanged.

Each icon has an aria-label and a hover title. `prefers-reduced-motion` stops the animations.

The user guide now has a sentence about the new markers.

## Not in this PR

`queued` and `refining` have no marker. I treated them as not active yet.

## Tested

- `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass (217 tests).
- Checked in the browser with Playwright against a throwaway stack, with one job in each state.

copilot_findings.label: The new active-state markers use the same size and corner as the blocked icon, so a card with both draws one over the other
